items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: And her mother then was called Zaire

ctx.x: Well, you see, she was my great-grandmother Was only eight years old when she was brought here So she don't remember, but very little She remember her father's name, Drosin Prince Prince Drosin Prince was his name And her mother then was called Zaire But her, she was only eight years old when they brought her here To the Senegalia in Africa, ain't it? On the border of the French, somewhere around there And they had an old man in the yard, they called Paraco He was the only one that spoke that Senegal language And…
You don't remember any songs that they had?
